cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Outdo the Effort
cards.instruction: Answer every favor, chore, or sacrifice with a bigger one that restores your lead.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thanks for the lift. I'll cover your Saturday shift. Send a proper handover, please, not a list of first names.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: No need. I covered yours yesterday so you could rest.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll take your whole weekend. Exact start and finish times; I don't leave people half-covered.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've already swapped Sunday so I can drive you to the airport.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll cancel the flight and cover your entire holiday. Send every date, including travel days. We cover the absence, not just the nights in a hotel.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 handover quality, A3 exact shift times and A5 travel-day coverage make A professional precision enlarge each reciprocal favour.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 previous cover causes A3 weekend; B4 airport sacrifice causes A5 trip cancellation and holiday cover.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 offer real support and do not demand repayment, making A escalating generosity self-driven.

heightening.evidence: A5 sacrifices A own flight to replace B4 transport favour with a longer period of cover.

specificity.evidence: A1 lift and shifts, B4 Sunday flight and A5 holiday cover state the relevant commitments.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 absence-versus-hotel-nights distinction specifies the larger gift rather than announces its competitive scale.
